title: Research Infrastructure Schemas
description: Schemas for _manifest.json, _index.json, and actions.json — shared across all pipelines. See references/research-storage.md for protocols.

summary.description: Natural-language summary for LLM navigation. ≤200 chars.

pipeline_type.description: Pipeline identifier — also the prefix of the run directory name

unit_status.description: pending=not started, in_progress=started, complete=output written, failed=errored, skipped=intentionally omitted

pipeline_status.description: Top-level pipeline status. 'complete' only when all phases including 6_report are done.

started_at.description: Set when status transitions to in_progress

completed_at.description: Set when status transitions to complete

error.description: Error description when status is failed

phase3_item_tasks.description: Per-task status for a single item in phase 3 deep research

phase3_tracking.description: Per-item tracking for pipelines with per-app/per-item deep research (Phase 3)

items.description: Keyed by item slug (app slug for ASO, domain slug for SEO, competitor slug for competitive intelligence)

manifest.title: _manifest.json
manifest.description: Pipeline status for resume logic. Updated immediately after each unit of work completes. Never mark a unit complete before its output file exists.

platform.description: Primary platform for this run. Required for ASO, optional for others.

phases.description: Phase keys vary by pipeline type. Common pattern: 0_intake through 6_report.

phase3.description: Per-item tracking for Phase 3 deep research. Present only when pipeline has per-item work.

files.description: Output file paths relative to the run directory

directory.description: For phases that write to a subdirectory (e.g. phase3/)

summary.description: Pulled from the _summary of the phase output file

index.title: _index.json
index.description: LLM table of contents. Updated after every phase completes by pulling _summary from each output file. Read this first to decide which full files to load.

_summary.description: Natural-language summary of the entire pipeline run. ≤300 chars (higher limit than per-file summaries because it summarizes all phases).

phases.description: Keyed by phase identifier (e.g. 0_intake, 1_keywords). Only completed phases have entries.

source_phase.description: Phase that generated this recommendation, e.g. phase5

status.description: pending=not yet done, implemented=done (set implemented_at), deferred=postponed (set notes), rejected=declined (set notes)

actions.title: actions.json
actions.description: Tracks whether pipeline recommendations are implemented and their outcomes. Created after Phase 5, updated as user reports progress.
